primary.title: Invested in gold, silver, debt or equity ETFs? Check how capital gains tax maths differs across these mutual funds
primary.summary: Gold, silver, equity and debt ETFs do not face the same tax treatment when you sell. The holding period, type of ETF and size of gains can affect how much tax you pay. Here’s a look at the key rules and how the tax maths works for each category.
